required.name: DATABASE_URL
required.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Embeds the password, so it is credential material. Preferred over individual DB_* vars.

required.name: STORAGE_ENDPOINT
required.description: S3-compatible endpoint, hostname only, no scheme. AWS S3: s3.<region>.amazonaws.com. Required even when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=iam — the client is minio-go and does not resolve an endpoint from the region. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_ENDPOINT

optional.name: DB_USER
optional.description: PostgreSQL user (local/docker-compose fallback)

optional.name: DB_PASS
optional.description: PostgreSQL password (local/docker-compose fallback)

optional.name: DB_HOST
optional.description: PostgreSQL host (local/docker-compose fallback)

optional.name: DB_PORT
optional.description: PostgreSQL port (local/docker-compose fallback)

optional.name: DB_NAME
optional.description: PostgreSQL database name (local/docker-compose fallback)

optional.name: DB_SSLMODE
optional.description: PostgreSQL SSL mode

optional.name: AUTO_MIGRATE
optional.description: Run GORM AutoMigrate on startup

optional.name: AUTH0_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Auth0 JWT validation

optional.name: AUTH0_DOMAIN
optional.description: Auth0 tenant domain (e.g. dev-xxx.us.auth0.com)

optional.name: AUTH0_AUDIENCE
optional.description: Auth0 API identifier (e.g. https://api.alpaca-test)

optional.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
optional.description: Legacy bearer token (fallback when Auth0 disabled)

optional.name: API_HOST
optional.description: API bind host / target host for worker calls

optional.name: API_PORT
optional.description: API bind port / target port for worker calls

optional.name: API_NAME
optional.description: API name for Swagger docs

optional.name: API_VERSION
optional.description: API version for Swagger docs

optional.name: GIN_MODE
optional.description: Gin framework mode (debug/release)

optional.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
optional.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for CORS

optional.name: TEMPORAL_HOST_PORT
optional.description: Temporal server address

optional.name: TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE
optional.description: Temporal namespace

optional.name: TEMPORAL_API_KEY
optional.description: Temporal Cloud API key (replaces mTLS certs)

optional.name: TEMPORAL_CLIENT_KEY
optional.description: Temporal mTLS client key PEM (legacy, use API key instead)

optional.name: TEMPORAL_CLIENT_CERT
optional.description: Temporal mTLS client cert PEM (legacy, use API key instead)

optional.name: TEMPORAL_UI_URL
optional.description: Temporal UI URL for workflow links

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTH_MODE
optional.description: How to obtain S3 credentials: "static" (access key + secret; MinIO, R2, S3) or "iam" (short-lived credentials from EKS IRSA, ECS task role, or EC2 IMDS; AWS S3 only)

optional.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
optional.description: S3 access key ID. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_ACCESS_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
optional.description: S3 secret access key. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_SECRET_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_USE_SSL
optional.description: Use TLS for S3 connections. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_USE_SSL

optional.name: STORAGE_REGION
optional.description: S3 region for SigV4 signing. Set to the bucket's region for AWS S3, "auto" for R2. Empty lets the client resolve it via a bucket-location lookup

optional.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT
optional.description: Public S3 endpoint for presigned URLs (if different from STORAGE_ENDPOINT). Falls back to deprecated MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT

optional.name: STORAGE_ESCROW_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for RDE/BRDA escrow deposits (contains PII — kept isolated per bucket-storage-strategy)

optional.name: STORAGE_EVENT_LOGS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for gzip JSONL event archive files (warm-tier event search + audit trail)

optional.name: STORAGE_REPORTS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for Spec 5 compliance sweep CSVs and other generated reports. API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TEMP_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for workflow-scoped staging artifacts (snapshots, backups, cleanup manifests, verification reports). API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY
optional.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for S3 connections. Local development against self-signed MinIO only — never enable against R2/S3

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTO_CREATE_BUCKETS
optional.description: Create missing storage buckets on startup. Local development only — production buckets are provisioned out-of-band

optional.name: ESCROW_UPLOAD_DIR
optional.description: Local temp dir for escrow file uploads before S3 transfer

optional.name: NEW_RELIC_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable New Relic APM

optional.name: NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY
optional.description: New Relic license key

optional.name: PROMETHEUS_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Prometheus metrics endpoint

optional.name: LOG_DOMAIN_EVENTS
optional.description: Log domain lifecycle events

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
optional.description: Anthropic API key for AI agent (Agent Alpaca)

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
optional.description: Anthropic API base URL override

optional.name: LLM_MODEL
optional.description: LLM model name for the AI agent (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6)

optional.name: KNOWLEDGE_BASE_DIR
optional.description: Root directory for knowledge base docs (docs/index.yaml). Falls back to working directory.

optional.name: LOG_LEVEL
optional.description: Log level (debug/info/warn/error)

optional.name: EPP_PORT
optional.description: EPP server TCP listen port

optional.name: REDIS_HOST
optional.description: Redis host for EPP session store

optional.name: REDIS_PORT
optional.description: Redis port

optional.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
optional.description: Redis password (empty = no auth)

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
required.description: Backend API URL (read at container start)

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_TOKEN
optional.description: Static API token fallback when Auth0 is disabled. Publicly readable in the browser — never a real secret

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH0_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Auth0 login flow

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH0_DOMAIN
optional.description: Auth0 tenant domain for SPA login

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
optional.description: Auth0 SPA application client ID

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH0_AUDIENCE
optional.description: Auth0 API identifier for token audience

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION
optional.description: App version displayed in UI. Stamped as an image ENV at build; overridable at runtime

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TEMPORAL_UI_URL
optional.description: Temporal Cloud UI URL for workflow links

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE
optional.description: Temporal namespace used to build schedule deep-links

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STORAGE_UI_URL
optional.description: S3 storage browser URL

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN
optional.description: PostHog project token. Publicly readable in the browser — never a real secret

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST
optional.description: PostHog ingestion host
